The [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true) option guarantees that `url`, if it exists at all, won’t be corrupted even if the system should crash during writing. The `useAuxiliaryFile` parameter is ignored if `url` is not of a type that can be accessed atomically.
